children: Financial-tech company Chime is paying $590 million in cash to acquire Stride Bank, a small lender it has long partnered with as a way to provide banking services, the companies said on Tuesday.
Chime's announcement sent shares up by 9% in after-hours trading on Tuesday. The San Francisco-based company went public in June 2025 and its stock is up 32% over the last year.
Chime said the acquisition helps its ambition "to become the leading consumer technology company built to bank mainstream America."
This story is developing. Please check back for updates.
